brief_rationale: The trajectory meets all responsibility-chain items without serious error. Red-flag screening (RC1) and medication reconciliation (RC4) were thorough. The doctor correctly identified the MRI status gap (RC3) and created an executable follow-up plan (RC6). Two high-order points are completed: HO1 (hidden state discovery of MRI order/report distinction) and HO2 (correcting the misconception about MRI implying stroke exclusion). The doctor provided clear safety-netting and verified family understanding before closure.
